title: Rotten Woods
description: This mod adds a new biome to the game consisting of rotten trees and a new wood type.
body: This Minecraft mod adds a new biome, the Rotten Woods. A barren wasteland that loooks similar to the aftermath of a nuclear fallout. Rotting trees can be found and collected and used for decoration even though they ugly. There isn't much to explore yet but more will (probably) be added later.
